def pin(raw):
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()}


def captured(path):
    before = path.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(), path
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    after = path.lstat()
    assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_mode) == (
        after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_mode)
    return raw, {**pin(raw), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode), 'git_mode': '100644'}


def wire(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value, *, raw=False):
    body = value if raw else wire(value)
    path = HERE / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        assert stream.write(body) == len(body)
    assert path.read_bytes() == body
    return pin(body)


def assignment(module, name):
    values = [node.value for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
              and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)
              and node.targets[0].id == name]
    assert len(values) == 1, name
    return ast.literal_eval(values[0])


def normalize_words(text):
    return re.sub(r'@([^@]+)@', lambda m: '_word_' + sha256(m[1].encode()).hexdigest(), text)


def dump(node):
    return ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)


def span(text, first, last):
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    return (sum(map(len, lines[:first.lineno-1])) + first.col_offset,
            sum(map(len, lines[:last.end_lineno-1])) + last.end_col_offset)


parents = {}

for name in PARENT_PATHS:
    raw, identity = captured(BASE / name)
    parents[name] = identity
    parent_raw[name] = raw
ordinary_module = ast.parse(parent_raw['tools/generate_hia_selfhost.py'])
template = assignment(ordinary_module, 'SOURCE')
generator_raw = (HERE / 'source' / NEW_PATHS[0]).read_bytes()
generator_ast = ast.parse(generator_raw)
old_emission = assignment(generator_ast, 'OLD_EMISSION')
new_emission = assignment(generator_ast, 'NEW_EMISSION')
prelude = normalize_words(assignment(generator_ast, 'CONST_PRELUDE'))
old_ast = ast.parse(normalize_words(template))
instruction = next(node for node in old_ast.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
                   and node.name == 'instruction')
const_test = ast.parse('op == ' + normalize_words('@const@'), mode='eval').body
arms = [node for node in ast.walk(instruction) if isinstance(node, ast.If)
        and dump(node.test) == dump(const_test)]
assert len(arms) == 1
arm = arms[0]
assert [dump(node) for node in arm.body] == [dump(node) for node in ast.parse(prelude+'\n'+old_emission).body]
expected_new = ast.parse('''if x < 4294967296:
    emit(o, w, 184)
    emit4(o, w, x)
else:
    emit(o, w, 72)
    emit(o, w, 184)
    emit8(o, w, x)
''')
assert dump(ast.parse(new_emission)) == dump(expected_new)
new_ast = deepcopy(old_ast)
new_instruction = next(node for node in new_ast.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
                       and node.name == 'instruction')
new_arm = next(node for node in ast.walk(new_instruction) if isinstance(node, ast.If)
               and dump(node.test) == dump(const_test))
new_arm.body[-3:] = deepcopy(expected_new.body)
restored = deepcopy(new_ast)
restore_instruction = next(node for node in restored.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
                           and node.name == 'instruction')
restore_arm = next(node for node in ast.walk(restore_instruction) if isinstance(node, ast.If)
                   and dump(node.test) == dump(const_test))
restore_arm.body[-1:] = deepcopy(arm.body[-3:])
assert dump(restored) == dump(old_ast)

# Source positions for replacement are taken from the raw template: replacing
# @tokens@ changes column widths, but not the three plain emit lines or their
# line numbers. Only their columns are used at these all-ASCII terminal lines.
begin, end = span(template, arm.body[-3], arm.body[-1])
indent = ' ' * arm.body[-3].col_offset
assert template[begin:end] == ('\n'+indent).join(old_emission.splitlines())
after_template = template[:begin] + ('\n'+indent).join(new_emission.splitlines()) + template[end:]
assert dump(ast.parse(normalize_words(after_template))) == dump(new_ast)
signed_template = assignment(ast.parse(parent_raw['tools/hia_selfhost_signed.py']), 'SOURCE')
literal = next(node for node in ast.parse(normalize_words(signed_template)).body
               if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'scalar_literal')
assert isinstance(literal.returns, ast.Name) and literal.returns.id == 'u64'

    'normalization': 'Only @word@ placeholders become deterministic Python identifier names for AST comparison; no keyword/emitter/source-program author function executed.',

    'full_expanded_projection_gate': 'Implemented in generator source_program/projection_report; pending first authorized generation.'}
save('TEMPLATE-PROJECTION.json', template_proof)
